Maria (PM): Quick async check — Orion Health private rollout: where are we on the two outstanding network blockers and the signed artifacts? Need a short status for Friday exec sync.
Alex (eng-platform): Working through the artifact signing step. I hit a CI flake yesterday that prevented the final zip from being published to the airgap registry.
Tina (eng-infra): Pinged CI infra this morning, they identified a flaky nodepool scaling bug. Fix merged, rollout underway. I expect publish to succeed within the hour.
Jess (network): On the egress side: customer asked for an allowlist for our control plane IPs + a fallback to our egress relay in the event of NAT issues. I posted the proposed ACLs in the SOC ticket.
Maria (PM): @Jess can you paste the minimal ACL snippet here so we can include it in the customer preflight?
Jess (network): Sure — minimal snippet they need (customer VRF):
```
permit ip 10.100.0.0/16 -> 52.14.32.0/24
permit tcp host 10.100.5.12 eq 443 -> 34.210.11.77 eq 8443
```
They also need outbound DNS to our resolver 10.200.1.53 and tcp 22 blocked except from ops bastions.
Alex (eng-platform): Re: artifacts — once CI finishes upload, deploy-bot will sign and push to the airgap bundle bucket. I have a local patch to skip the flaky test if infra rollout not ready; will open a short PR (no behaviour change).
deploy-bot: artifact build 2026-04-01-1130 completed, queued for signing.
Tina (eng-infra): CI nodepool finished rolling, logs look green. Alex — your PR looks small, but can you add a one-line note in the PR description about the test skip rationale for audit?
Alex (eng-platform): Yup will do, adding now. PR: https://stash/repo/PR/4128 (short desc added).
Ron (security): Quick security note: the customer requires HSM-backed key wrapping for root KMS keys. Do we have an owner for the HSM integration path for private deploys?
Sam (oncall): I can own the initial smoke for the HSM flow during the cutover window next week. Need access to their HSM endpoint creds though.
Maria (PM): @Sam thanks. @Ron — can you confirm whether the HSM handshake requires any port exceptions beyond the ACL Jess posted?
Ron (security): Handshake uses outbound tls to the HSM VIP on 31000 and 31443. So add permit tcp -> <HSM_VIP> eq 31000, 31443. Also SNAT from the bastion subnet.
Jess (network): Noted — will add to the preflight doc and push to the customer. Also adding a fallback NAT rule in case their egress is stateful and drops the long session.
Maria (PM): Great — two quick blockers then: artifact signing finalization (Alex/Tina) and HSM egress ACL addition (Jess/Ron). Can owners confirm ETA?
Alex (eng-platform): Artifacts: CI and upload done, deploy-bot signing should finish in ~20m, then I’ll kick off the internal smoke. If smoke passes, we can ask customer to pull the bundle tonight.
Tina (eng-infra): Agree, CI done. ETA 20-30m.
Ron (security): HSM ACL changes — I can draft and send to customer in 2 hours after I get their HSM VIP.
Jess (network): Will add the rules to the preflight doc and send to customer once Ron confirms VIP. ETA 2.5h.
Maria (PM): Perfect. If either of you hit >2h delay, drop a short note here so I can escalate to customer ops.
Alex (eng-platform): Quick FYI — internal smoke will validate KV cache warmup and leader election in airgapped mode, small chance we'll need a hotfix. If smoke fails I’ll tag @Tina and @Sam.
Sam (oncall): Copy. I’m standing by for smoke notifications, will take the messaged pager if anything flips.
deploy-bot: signing complete — bundle pushed to s3://airgap-bundles/orion/2026-04-01-1152.tar.gz :thumbsup:
Alex (eng-platform): Bundle pulled and smoke started. Sharing quick smoke checklist: 1) certs present 2) control-plane connectivity 3) KV warm 4) gprc health checks 5) canary model load.
Jess (network): Sent ACLs and HSM ports to customer, they confirmed receiving.
Tina (eng-infra): Smoke green so far — KV warm and grpc checks passed, certs validated. Waiting on model load (canary).
Maria (PM): Amazing — can you all drop final status updates in the ticket and I’ll close this thread for the exec sync?
Alex (eng-platform): Will update ticket + assign post-mortem if we needed hotfix.
Sam (oncall): I updated oncall runbook with the temporary NAT fallback and added the oncall rotation for cutover night.
Maria (PM): Thanks everyone — closing here once tickets updated. :rocket:
